Reason for Mistake: The WebSurfer agent failed to correctly navigate to the specific GitHub issue (#22669) after the ComputerTerminal agent identified it. Instead of directly opening the known issue URL (https://github.com/numpy/numpy/issues/22669), the WebSurfer performed a search engine query ("I typed 'numpy github issues BUG: deep copying polybase broken created 2022-11-24T23:45:07Z' into '0 characters out of 2000'"), which led to a Bing search results page rather than the actual GitHub issue page. This unnecessary detour delayed the process and required additional steps to eventually locate the correct page. The mistake was in the navigation strategy; the agent should have been instructed to open a direct link rather than searching for it.
